title: ShenLingBaiZhu powder ameliorates obesity and atherosclerosis by inhibiting inflammation and apoptosis through the suppression of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Wu, Xize; Yuan, Changbin; Wang, Haotian; Pan, Xue; Wang, Ruiying; Cai, Qicheng; Huang, Yuxi; Ren, Jiaqi; Kang, Jian; Cheng, Meijia; Gao, Xiaoyu; Li, Yue; Yu, Kaifeng; Pan, Jiaxiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方参苓白术散通过TLR4/NF-κB通路改善肥胖与动脉粥样硬化，核心为炎症与凋亡机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: ShenLingBaiZhu Powder (SLBZP) is a renowned traditional Chinese medicinal formula that has been historically and clinically applied for managing obesity (OB) and atherosclerosis (AS). Nevertheless, its precise molecular mechanisms remain to be fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To systematically clarify the material basis and multi-target mechanisms of SLBZP against OB-AS comorbidity by integrating network pharmacology and experimental validation. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Bioinformatics analysis of public transcriptomic datasets was performed to identify common differentially expressed genes and Hub genes between OB and AS, which were validated in a cellular co-culture model of free fatty acid-induced differentiated 3T3-L1 adipocytes and oxidized low-density lipoprotein-induced RAW 264.7 macrophage foam cells. Bioactive compounds in SLBZP-containing serum were characterized by HPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS. Network pharmacology predicted potential targets and pathways. Finally, in vitro experiments were conducted to assess the effects of SLBZP on lipid accumulation, cell activity, inflammatory cytokine secretion, apoptosis, and key signaling pathways. RESULTS: Bioinformatics analysis identified 115 common crosstalk genes related to inflammation, immune responses, chemotaxis, and apoptosis in OB and AS comorbidity. Machine learning pinpointed three Hub genes, MNDA, PTPRC, and MMP9, which were upregulated in the comorbidity model. Mass spectrometry identified 62 specific compounds in the drug-containing serum. Network pharmacology predictions suggested that SLBZP might alleviate inflammation and apoptosis by regulating pathways such as NF-kappaB. In vitro experiments demonstrated that adipocytes under pathological conditions promoted macrophage foam cell formation, whereas SLBZP significantly inhibited lipid accumulation, reduced levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL6, IL1beta, TNF), and decreased apoptosis. These protective effects were antagonized by a TLR4 agonist, indicating the involvement of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway. Molecular docking indicated high binding affinity of chenodeoxycholic acid, genistein, and 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid to key targets of pathways and apoptosis. CONCLUSIONS: MNDA, PTPRC, and MMP9 may serve as potential biomarkers for OB and AS comorbidity. SLBZP alleviates the comorbid process by improving lipid metabolism, suppressing inflammation, and inhibiting apoptosis, mechanisms likely associated with modulation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：参苓白术散（SLBZP）是一种著名的中药复方，历史上和临床上已被用于治疗肥胖（OB）和动脉粥样硬化（AS）。然而，其精确的分子机制仍有待充分阐明。研究目的：通过整合网络药理学和实验验证，系统阐明SLBZP对抗OB-AS共病的物质基础和多靶点机制。材料与方法：对公共转录组数据集进行生物信息学分析，以识别OB和AS之间的常见差异表达基因和Hub基因，并在游离脂肪酸诱导的分化3T3-L1脂肪细胞和氧化低密度脂蛋白诱导的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞泡沫细胞的细胞共培养模型中进行验证。通过HPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS表征含SLBZP血清中的生物活性化合物。网络药理学预测了潜在靶点和通路。最后，进行体外实验以评估SLBZP对脂质积累、细胞活性、炎症细胞因子分泌、凋亡和关键信号通路的影响。结果：生物信息学分析识别出115个与OB和AS共病中炎症、免疫反应、趋化性和凋亡相关的常见串扰基因。机器学习确定了三个Hub基因，即MNDA、PTPRC和MMP9，它们在共病模型中表达上调。质谱分析在含药血清中鉴定出62种特定化合物。网络药理学预测表明，SLBZP可能通过调节NF-kappaB等通路来缓解炎症和凋亡。体外实验表明，病理条件下的脂肪细胞促进了巨噬细胞泡沫细胞的形成，而SLBZP显著抑制了脂质积累，降低了促炎细胞因子（IL6、IL1beta、TNF）的水平，并减少了凋亡。这些保护效应被TLR4激动剂拮抗，表明TLR4/NF-kappaB通路参与其中。分子对接显示鹅去氧胆酸、染料木黄酮和18β-甘草次酸对通路和凋亡的关键靶点具有高结合亲和力。结论：MNDA、PTPRC和MMP9可能作为OB和AS共病的潜在生物标志物。SLBZP通过改善脂质代谢、抑制炎症和抑制凋亡来缓解共病过程，其机制可能与调节TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路有关。
